title: GRAVY
instructions: Use pork fat cut up and fried crisp. Then rub smooth one tablespoonful of Quong Sang Chong (water-chestnut flour) or rice flour in cold water, and stir it slowly into the boiling fat until it thickens and browns. Add syou,  salt,  pepper, and a little sugar. In preparing chop sueys and similar dishes, use this gravy
if the mixture is too dry.
